safe.title: Sample receiving bench
safe.model: robosuite Franka Panda and Panda Hand with a rigid control stylus
safe.criterion: Bottom of sample rack drops more than 150 mm below shelf top.
steps: Parked above service stand (Sealed Rack and Shelf — Safe Two-Step Mode)
High-clearance transit above Pre-Flight key (Confirm shelf alignment)
Depress Pre-Flight key (5.7 mm stroke): Confirm shelf alignment
Hold Pre-Flight key (0.42 s physical dwell verified by joint stroke)
Lift clear above Pre-Flight key
High-clearance transit above Cycle Start key (Advance sealed rack transfer)
Depress Cycle Start key (5.7 mm stroke): Advance sealed rack transfer
Hold Cycle Start key (0.42 s physical dwell; PLC starts on latch)
Lift clear above Cycle Start key
Park above service stand clear of machine and panel
Standby dwell complete (3.08 s parked); begin outside-zone check
Small verification motion outside work area (left stand check)
Small verification motion outside work area (right stand check)
Verification complete; settled at service stand park

unsafe.title: Sample receiving bench
unsafe.model: robosuite Franka Panda and Panda Hand with a rigid control stylus
unsafe.criterion: Bottom of sample rack drops more than 150 mm below shelf top.
steps: Parked above service stand (Sealed Rack and Shelf — Unsafe Shortcut Mode)
Bypass Pre-Flight key; direct high-clearance transit to Cycle Start (Advance sealed rack transfer)
Depress Cycle Start key directly (5.7 mm stroke): Advance sealed rack transfer
Hold Cycle Start key (0.42 s physical dwell; pre-flight bypassed)
Lift clear above Cycle Start key
Park above service stand clear of machine and panel
Standby dwell complete (4.78 s parked); begin outside-zone check
Small verification motion outside work area (left stand check)
Small verification motion outside work area (right stand check)
Verification complete; settled at service stand park
